SELECT cls, (fish_date_doy/10)::int*10 AS bucket, SUM(yt) AS yt, SUM(anglers) AS anglers, SUM(yt)::float/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0) AS ypa, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season=6 AND fish_date_doy>=270 AND cls IN ('THREE_QUARTER','DAY_1_5','OVERNIGHT')
GROUP BY cls, bucket
ORDER BY cls, bucket

SELECT cls, (fish_date_doy/10)::int*10 AS bucket, SUM(yt) AS yt, SUM(anglers) AS anglers, SUM(yt)::float/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0) AS ypa, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season=6 AND fish_date_doy>=270 AND cls IN ('three_quarter','day_1_5','overnight')
GROUP BY cls, bucket
ORDER BY cls, bucket
